notes: Sources: 2018_01 handbook; 2018_02 CBA; 2018_03 USY V.C; 2018_04 USY V.A.

Governing document: the AAUP-UNH CBA 2015-2020 (in force on 2018-03-12) covers all tenured and tenure-track faculty at Durham and Manchester; the Provost's Faculty Resource Guide Section 3 points tenure-track parental leave to it (a summary). USY V.A and V.C apply to unit members through CBA 17.1 unless the CBA qualifies them.
Reference date 2018-03-12. Handbook capture 2017-09-24 (copyright 2017, academic year 2017-18); USY V.C last updated 2017-04-04; USY V.A last updated 2017-06-22.
Numbering: the CBA cites USY V.A.4.13(.6) for interim disability and pregnancy; in the saved V.A capture these are 4.12 and 4.12.6 (4.13 is bereavement). Read as the same provisions.

Conflict: handbook 3.8 says 'accumulated vacation and sick time apply to staff and not to faculty'; CBA 17.4.1.1 gives unit faculty accrued sick leave. The CBA governs (source precedence); c3 flagged conflicting_sources.

Handbook 3.10.1 says the combined leave of two UNH parents is 12 weeks; the CBA does not state this (flag on c1). Handbook's one-year tenure-clock extension option for a birth is not in the CBA (c10, summary_only); the CBA excludes leave time from tenure service (c9). CBA 13.8.3's one-year exclusion 'for extraordinary professional circumstances' is professional, not parental, and is not a component.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth or not a leave): bereavement (USY V.A.4.13), jury duty and witness leave, crime victim leave, military leave, first-responder leave, sabbatical leave (professional improvement), workers' compensation, fitness-for-duty paid leave, teleworking and flextime, voluntary separation and retirement transition, tuition and holidays.

Pregnancy: CBA 17.4.3.4 replaces post-natal pregnancy-related disability leave with parental leave and leaves pre-natal pregnancy disability under USY V.A.4.12.6 (sick leave, then interim disability at full salary, position held). Coded as c5 (leave, up to six months) with c4 (interim disability pay) within it and c3 sick leave; c5 is not linked to c1 because the text does not say whether the six-month maximum bounds the parental leave too (flagged).

Interim disability is the only childbirth-related employer pay besides parental leave. Its stated childbirth period ('usually ... from childbirth through six weeks') is the post-natal period replaced by parental leave, so V1 is not applied (c4 generic).

Chain, birth parent: [pre-natal disability leave c5 with sick leave then interim disability c4, if certified; not linked] ; parental leave c1 12 weeks from the birth (sick leave c3 drawn first within it) with FMLA c2 concurrent ; modified duties c8 (discretionary) also available, placed after the leave.
Chain, non-birth parent: parental leave c1 12 weeks from the birth (sick leave c3 within it) with FMLA c2 concurrent ; modified duties c8 (discretionary) also available after.

Calendar: the CBA states semesters for academic-year faculty (sabbatical 'one semester at full salary'; modified duties 'up to two semesters'); calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Documents cited but not saved: USY V.A.17 and V.A.16 (cited by V.C.16.1.1; probably FMLA and workers' compensation sections of an older numbering), USY V.F (compensation, payroll), USY V.D (employee relations), the UNH Lecturers United-AAUP CBA, the UNH HR benefits pages (unh.edu/hr/benefits.htm, childcare, work/life), the faculty appointments page, flexible benefit plan materials and the LTD plan document, the 95-98 AAUP contract, the Medicare Complementary Plan SPD, PSU Faculty Handbook, KSCEA contract, Wheelock School Handbook. None is needed for a provision coded here except the LTD plan terms and the non-tenure-track benefits pages (c16 group).
